title: A Day at the Zoo
text: Today is Saturday, and my family is at the zoo. The sun is hot, and the sky is blue. First, we look at the lions. They are big, but they are very lazy. They sleep in the sun all day!
Next, we go to the monkeys. The monkeys jump and play. Oh no! One monkey has my brother's hat! Everybody laughs. After lunch, we see a giraffe. It is very tall. It eats leaves from a tree.
Now it is evening. We are tired, but we are happy. I love the zoo!
qs: How does the family feel in the evening?
